QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #4
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: A request was made from Maple Admin to make a White Crewneck Shirt for him. Actually, a 100 of them!!! Oh wow... how am I going to make them all?\n\n#i4001177# #t4001177# #b#c4001177# / 100
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Maple Admin to produce White Crewneck Shirts for beginnings, and asked me to do it for him. It was quite daunting to even think about making a 100 of them, but how can I say no to the Maple Admin?? I worked hard and gave Keol all 100 of them, but he still gave me a hard time about the shirts.

0.0: This is really a special order. This means our company is slowly being recognized by the people in Maple. I don't understand what Moren is thinking for him to give you an order like this.
0.1: You better know that I was firmly against this move until the bitter end. Keep that in mind. If you are indeed interested in making this, I'll tell you what the request is. This is a huge task, so I STRONGLY suggest you backing out if you aren't ready.

yes.0: This is a purchase order directly from Maple Admin. She's looking for us to make some White Crewneck Shirts for beginners. As you can see in the purchase order, she's actually looking for #b100 #t4001177#s#k. You better be ready, newb. You better be.

no.0: That was a wise choice. No perseverence, no chutzpah... how can I say this... I thought you'd be dumb enough to actually do this, but... of course.

1.0: You've got some perseverence there. I honestly didn't think you'd be able to do it, since 100 is a big number. As an item-producer, I'll give you tiny bit of credit for that.

item.0: Did you really read the purchase order I wrote for you? Or are you here to tell me you are incapable of making this easy, easy item and that you will actually quit? I guess you wanted to at least keep your dignity intact by quitting. That's a wise choice, I say. I can't imagine an item-producer that can't even make #b#t4001177##k.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
